newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel eyes 130.00 despite hang over.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel eyes 130.00 despite hang over.

text.p: September notionnel futures on MATIF are struggling to challenge new peaks, and some sideways action can be expected on Thursday, analysts said.
But overall, prospects for it to clear the psychological 130.00 are intact as long as support at 129.25 is undisturbed.
Susan Rigg of Chart Analysis in London said notionnel charts were looking constructive after Wednesday's rally.
"If it breaks up and closes above 130.00 then it's going to push up towards higher levels," she said. "With a bit of luck it's going to hold above 129.25."
By 0810 GMT, September notionnel was 0.08 down at 129.58.
